purpose: Token/episode-matched ACTIVE CONTROL for the mini-flywheel arm C. Controls the data-quantity confound (corpus vs corpus+portfolio compares MORE vs LESS data): arm C gets the same number of extra games x seeds as arm B, but drawn from the BOTTOM of the funnel. Headline contrast = arm B (top-12) minus arm C (this file). Design rationale: reports/2026-06-10_growth-score-precedents-and-validity.md (criterion repo), fatal-2.
selection_rules: all gate-passed (executable, terminating) — this is an ACTIVE control, not dead weight
k_confirmed = 0 only (failed the necessity test entirely)

include the 4 p=1.0 trivial games portfolio_v1 excluded: winnable and reward-dense but shallow — ensures arm C has real RL signal, so B-C isolates content quality, not 'any RL happened' (spurious-reward concern, arXiv 2506.10947)
fill with k=0 tier=random (random-walk winnable: reward reachable for GRPO), then k=0 tier=bfs, minimal tier=none
match arm B episode budget exactly: 12 games x same seeds-per-game

games.why: TRIVIAL: p=1.0 (frozen model always wins) — reward-dense, zero depth; k=0, B4 perturbation fails_necessity
TRIVIAL: p=1.0; k=0, B3+B4 both fail_necessity
TRIVIAL: p=1.0; k=0, B3+B4 both fail_necessity
k=0 (A1 fails_necessity), tier=random — random-walk winnable, no confirmed primitive
k=0 (A4 fails), tier=bfs — solvable but not by random walk
k=0, tier=none, funnel score 0.0 — one bottom-anchor dud (kept to 1 to avoid an all-dead control)

training_notes.episode_matching: use identical --seeds-per-game as arm B (64) so arm B and arm C parquets have identical row counts (768 train / 96 val)
training_notes.token_matching: episode-matched by construction; report total prompt+rollout token counts per arm post hoc (game code/render lengths differ slightly)
training_notes.harness: identical generic text harness and GRPO recipe as arms A/B; paired seeds with arm B
